{{Quote|Shuttle number LMTR-20, prepare for takeoff while we check your authorization.|Rebel technician|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
'''LMTR-20''' was a [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] that was owned by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. It was used by [[Captain]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], [[Jyn Erso]], and [[K-2SO]]<ref name="Rogue One" /> during [[Operation Fracture]].<ref name="Rebel Dossier">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Rebel Dossier]]''</ref>
